d.ko: Total War: ROME REMASTERED lets you relive the legacy that defined the award-winning strategy game series. Remastered to 4K with multiple improvements to visuals as well as refinements to gameplay, it’s time to revisit a true classic. Not everyone gets a second chance to conquer the Roman Empire.

d.zh: 《Total War: ROME REMASTERED》将带领您回味为屡获殊荣的策略游戏系列打下基石的传奇之作。重制版不仅配以 4K 分辨率的画面，令画质大幅升级，更优化了游戏机制——现在就来重温真正的经典之作，毕竟不是每个人都有再次征服罗马帝国的机会！
